title: Authorizer
description: Optional external OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 policy decision point (PDP) replacing Plat5's built-in RBAC for the whole deployment.

authorizer.title: authorizer
authorizer.description: External OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP configuration. Mutually exclusive with `roles`, `creator_role`, `custom_roles`, and `permissions`.

url.title: url
url.description: Base URL of an OpenID AuthZEN 1.0 PDP (`http://` or `https://`, optional path prefix without trailing slash, no credentials or query). Plat5 appends `/access/v1/evaluation` and `/access/v1/evaluations`.

timeout.title: timeout
timeout.description: HTTP timeout for each AuthZEN request, as a duration (`2s`). Default `2s`.

cache_ttl.title: cache_ttl
cache_ttl.description: How long the gateway caches positive (`decision: true`) answers from the authorizer (`0s` disables caching). Default `0s`.

negative_cache_ttl.title: negative_cache_ttl
negative_cache_ttl.description: How long the gateway caches negative (`decision: false`) answers from the authorizer (`0s` disables caching). Default `0s`.

token_env.title: token_env
token_env.description: Optional environment variable name on the gateway and identity holding a bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <value>` to the PDP. Never put plaintext secrets in config.

non_negative_duration.title: non-negative duration
non_negative_duration.description: A whole number (`0` or positive) and a unit: `s`, `m`, `h` or `d`.

resource.title: resource
resource.description: Optional AuthZEN resource override for a kind-scoped route or verb (`{ type, id }`), valid only when top-level `authorizer` is configured. Defaults to the route's scope kind and leaf node id. `id` accepts `{<kind>.id}`, `{member.id}`, and route `{param}` placeholders.
